plans.idea: Centred testimonial card: one tall, full-width text block sits in the vertical middle so the quote mark, a large multi-line quote and the attribution stack as one tight group, with even breathing room above and below and a tiny minor slot tucked at the foot.

Top-anchored editorial column: the quote starts high, like a magazine pull-quote, so the oversized quote mark leads the eye down a long, narrow column of large serif lines into the attribution, leaving a calm block of beige below as deliberate negative space.

Bottom-weighted story layout: a quiet top band holds the minor slot as a header, and the quote block fills the lower two-thirds so the large text sits on a strong bottom baseline, reading top to bottom like a phone story.
